The '''Bothawui Defense Corps''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense unit which performed peacekeeping and intelligence operations. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Arkhan Brem'tu]] was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the Corps and conducted several operations on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. He observed the rise of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and later helped create [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel cells]].<ref name="Arkhan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bothawui Defense Corps was mentioned in Arkhan Brem'tu's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
